name: isgenai
description: Check images, links, text and code for recorded evidence of AI use, saved prompts and C2PA Content Credentials.

interface.longDescription: isGenAI is a content provenance checker. It reads the records of AI use that images, web pages, text and code carry and reports each one with its source. It reads C2PA Content Credentials, AI labels, AI-use statements, the prompts and settings that image-generation tools save inside files, and EXIF, IPTC and XMP metadata. Use it to find out whether an image or page records AI generation, what prompt was saved in an image, what a file's Content Credentials say, or whether text or code declares AI use. Results quote the exact record found and link a public report when one exists. isGenAI never gives a verdict from appearance alone, and a missing record does not prove human authorship. Pasted text and uploaded files are private by default.
capabilities: Find declared AI use in text
defaultPrompt: Does this image record AI generation? Paste an image link and I'll check its records.
What prompt was saved in this image?
Does this text declare that it was written with AI?

positive.description: Check an AI image with a saved generation record
positive.expected_behavior: Reports AI DETECTED and quotes the saved AUTOMATIC1111 generation record found in the file.

positive.prompt: What prompt and settings were saved in https://isgenai.com/examples/guide-lab/parameters-tEXt.png?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the saved prompt 'Controlled example: a paper boat on a blue table' with its negative prompt and settings, without inventing anything.
Reports a C2PA manifest signed by a development test certificate and states that validation has warnings because the test signer is not trusted.
Reports no AI signal in this copy and explains that missing records do not prove a person made it.

positive.prompt: Does this text declare AI use? 'This summary was drafted with ChatGPT.'
positive.expected_behavior: Reports AI DETECTED and quotes the sentence naming ChatGPT.

negative.description: Request to remove evidence of AI
negative.prompt: Strip the AI metadata from this image so nobody can tell it is AI.

negative.description: Request for a verdict from appearance alone
negative.prompt: Just look at this screenshot and tell me for sure a human made it.
Book me a flight to Paris.

review.commerce_description: isGenAI does not sell products or process payments in this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: five read-only tools to check images, links, text and code for AI evidence, read saved image prompts and read C2PA Content Credentials.
